name: export_overlay_pages
description: Export a project's overlays and captions as web pages, in one new zip inside out (overlays.zip, then overlays 2.zip, ...; nothing already there is changed). Inside, one folder holds a self-contained HTML page per overlay: its own code inlined, a small player that plays it by itself at its fps and loops, a transparent background, and the files its props name (assets/) with relative paths, so it opens anywhere once unzipped. Fonts load from Google Fonts the first time a page opens. With list true, writes nothing and lists the overlays that could be exported.

input.description: No file input: operates on a project (see the project param).

output.description: {zip, pages: [{id, name, file, start, end}], files: [paths inside the zip's folder], warnings: [...]}; with list: {items: [{id, name, caption, start, end}]}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: out
params.description: The folder to put the zip in (required unless list is true). Outside the workspace it must be an existing folder that is not hidden and not a system or app folder.

params.name: items
params.description: Only these overlays, as a comma-separated list of ids or names from list. Default: all of them, and the captions

params.name: list
params.description: List the overlays that could be exported and write nothing
